headline: Exchange Inflows Fell To 325.9 Million Dollars As OKX Took In 220.1 Million
narrative: Exchanges took in 325.9 million dollars across assets over 24 hours, 0.1196 percent of custodied value excluding each venue's own token, down from 1,144.2 million dollars and 0.4195 percent. The figure is the change in dollars held on trading venues, so a positive print means that money arrived where holders can sell, and the smaller print means that arrival slowed. OKX took in 220.1 million dollars, Deribit took in 56.0 million, and Gate took in 50.0 million, while Bitget shed 69.4 million and Bybit shed 54.6 million.
author: jordan
